name: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger Vol. 8
original_name: グリザイア ファントムトリガー Vol. 8
source:
At last, an all-out war is at hand.

The battle against the religious organization, The Fatal Answer (TFA), has entered its final phase, with CIRS and SORD preparing to send all of their troops into TFA's stronghold.

The battlefield soon descends into total chaos. Black rain pours down, civilians become desperate for water, and shots are fired at friend and foe alike. Not even the trenches are safe from the anti-aircraft guns TFA employs, the explosions bombarding the combat zone that the girls are tasked with invading. Such a feat is not unlike invading the depths of hell itself.

The underground base is quickly being suffocated by gunpowder, and the dark forest that surrounds the battlefield reeks with the stench of death. But both contain within them the faint yet tenacious flames of life; will those flames be able to withstand the harsh realities of war?

This must never, ever be repeated again...

[From the [url=http://grisaia-pt.com/en/index.html#Story]official website[/url]]
translation:
全面战争终于迫在眉睫。

与宗教组织“致命答案”（TFA）的战斗已进入最后阶段，CIRS与SORD正准备投入全部兵力，攻入TFA的据点。

战场很快陷入彻底的混乱。黑雨倾盆而下，平民为求得饮水而挣扎，子弹不分敌我地四处飞射。TFA架设的高射炮让战壕也失去了庇护作用，爆炸不断轰击少女们奉命突入的交战区域。这项任务，无异于闯入地狱深处。

地下基地迅速被硝烟吞没，战场周围的幽暗森林也弥漫着死亡的气息。然而，在这两处地方，微弱而顽强的生命之火仍在燃烧。这些火苗，能否经受住战争残酷现实的考验？

这样的事，绝不能再度重演……

[摘自[url=http://grisaia-pt.com/en/index.html#Story]官方网站[/url]]
